subject: Capacity triage roundtable — commit windows & sprint signals
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity triage roundtable — commit windows & sprint signals

Team —

Quick sync request: orbit (OrbitAI) is asking for an updated reserve ask and a firm commit window for Q4 pilot capacity next week. They show a likely close in the 11/1–11/15 window (deal pipeline attached).

I pulled a short snapshot (attached) and highlighted two things we need to confirm ahead of Friday's triage roundtable:

- Commit quantum: they want 8 dedicated slots (A100 equivalent) for a 90-day pilot with potential expansion if throughput tests go well.
- Sprint window: they requested start week of 11/8 — we need to validate fleet availability and any conflicts with other high-priority commits.

Ask: please review the attached Q4_pipeline_snapshot.xlsx and reply in-thread with:
  1) feasible commit (slots, CPU/GPU type) we can hold to meet a 11/8 start;
  2) blockers (procurement lead time, infra constraints, reserved slot quotas) that would push us later;
  3) whether we should give Orbit a hard start date or an estimated window.

Attachments: Q4_pipeline_snapshot.xlsx, reserve_request_template.docx

I want to consolidate responses by EOD today so I can push an internal summary to Finance and the Account Exec before the triage call.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity triage roundtable — commit windows & sprint signals

Mina —

Skimming the snapshot. Orbit's expected token throughput looks reasonable for 8 slots if we use 8xA100 (sustained). Couple quick datapoints from Finance/Bookings I can share by EOD:
- Expected ARR uplift if pilot converts: $420k ARR (forecast in HubSpot).
- Pricing band: we'll need to offer a pilot discount; preliminary ask is 20% off list for the 90-day window — I'll flag this with Finance.

From a sales perspective: give them an "estimated start window" (11/8–11/15) rather than a hard date until infra confirms.

Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity triage roundtable — commit windows & sprint signals

Mina —

Infra constraints (short summary):
- Current reserve headroom for US-west A100 pool: 12 slots uncommitted through 11/12. After 11/12 we have 6 slots free due to scheduled reserve starts for two other pilots.
- Procurement lead time for reserved capacity (contracting + allocation) ~7 business days if legal and finance are aligned; procurement@orbitai.com will need to sign the standard reservation SOW.
- Burst/buffer policy: for a 90-day pilot we can offer 10% burst capacity subject to fleet load; that helps with transient spikes but not sustained throughput.

I attached infra_constraints_summary.pdf with the exact pool availability and a short risk matrix. TL;DR: we can support an 11/8 start if Orbit signs by 10/29 and we approve the reservation immediately. Slip risk otherwise.

- Jordan
Director, Infrastructure Capacity
Redwood Inference

Attachment: infra_constraints_summary.pdf

From: Sara Lim <sara@orbitai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orbitai.com
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity triage roundtable — commit windows & sprint signals

Mina —

Thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. Quick answers from our side:
- Orbit confirms intent: 8 slots (A100 equiv) for a 90-day pilot, with a possible +4 expansion after a successful throughput run.
- Procurement: procurement@orbitai.com is copied and has our legal team on standby. They can sign the SOW within 3 business days once we align on the pricing and start date.
- Start preference: preferred start 11/8, but can accept a window (11/8–11/15) if that helps Redwood manage capacity.

Forwarded message: On Tue, Oct 6, 2026 at 16:02 Sara Lim <sara@orbitai.com> wrote:
> Hi Procurement —
>
> Please prioritize the Redwood reservation SOW; Sales Ops needs a committed start date for our internal rollout plan.
>
> - Sara

Sara Lim
Director of Product
OrbitAI

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity triage roundtable — commit windows & sprint signals

Thanks for the fast turnarounds, team. Consolidated notes and next steps below (for the triage call Friday at 10:00am PT):

1) Feasibility
- Infra: can support 8 slots starting 11/8 if Orbit signs by 10/29 (Jordan).
- Sales: recommend estimated window 11/8–11/15 unless legal/procurement confirm earlier (Ben).

2) Financials/Commercials
- Finance: Ben to confirm pilot discount band (prelim 20%); need final from Finance this week.

3) Blockers/Risks
- Procurement lead time (signing SOW) is the critical path — Orbit says legal can move in 3 business days once pricing is agreed.
- Post-11/12 capacity decline due to two other scheduled reserves; flag for contingency if Orbit slips.

4) Action items
- Ben: escalate pilot discount approval to Finance (due 10/08 EOD).
- Jordan: freeze 8 slots tentatively for 48 hours pending SOW signature; share an updated pool heatmap by EOD Thursday.
- Mina: prepare the joint M.A.P. (mutual action plan) doc and send to Orbit + Procurement by 10/08. Use reserve_request_template.docx as the base.

I updated the HubSpot deal record and attached the snapshot + infra summary to the record (link above). If everyone is aligned I will push this as the official triage agenda item.

Mina
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
